svg.title: ROS Python callback intervals for two message formats

cc:Work.dc:title: ROS Python callback intervals for two message formats
cc:Work.dc:description: One 30-second full-rate single-stream Cyclone reference per format, Apple M5 Max / macOS arm64 / rclpy. Interval is publisher-call start to Python callback, including representation, deserialization and scheduling; not isolated DDS wire time. Includes five warmup packets in delivery counts.

cc:Agent.dc:title: MIT OR Apache-2.0; see NOTICE.md for model provenance.
